app_name.description: Title shown in the header, 2-4 words.

summary.description: One paragraph: what the app does for its user.

noun.description: The record's singular noun, lowercase, e.g. 'book'.

options.description: select only: the fixed choices, Title Case; [] otherwise

integer.description: number only: true when only whole numbers make sense (a count), false for a rating, price or measurement

in_form.description: false when only an action sets this value (a borrower, an owner)

message.description: validation message when required/invalid, e.g. 'Title is required.'; '' if not required

title_field.description: field name shown as each row's title

comment.description: one line: the vague phrase in the idea and the value chosen

field.description: kind=field: the select field to narrow by; '' for state

label.description: kind=state: the filter chip text; kind=field: the 'all' chip text, e.g. 'All kinds'

rule.description: kind=state: plain-English predicate over field names, e.g. 'borrower is not empty'; '' for field

empty_text.description: kind=state: shown when nothing matches; '' for field

text.description: what the user reads, with {fieldName} placeholders, e.g. 'Borrowed by {borrower}'

rule.description: 'count of all rows' | 'count of rows where <predicate>' | 'sum of <field>'

emphasis.description: true for the one headline figure the idea asks for

effect.description: plain-English field changes, e.g. 'set borrower to the input', 'clear borrower', 'decrease quantity by 1'; describe the field change only -- never mention a prompt, dialog or popup

input_label.description: label of the one value the user types; '' when none

confirm_text.description: warning to confirm before an irreversible action; '' when none

title.description: vitest title, lowercase verb phrase, e.g. 'adds a book and shows it in the list'

steps.description: the user actions, using field labels, option values and action labels verbatim

expect.description: what the user sees afterwards, verbatim visible text where possible

assumptions.description: each ambiguity and the decision made, one sentence each

message.content:
{
  "app_name": "Home Library",
  "tagline": "Track books on your shelves and who has borrowed them",
  "summary": "A single-record-type browser app for cataloguing books at home. Each book has a title, author, and category. You can mark a book as lent to someone and clear that when it comes back. The list shows everything you own, with a filter for books currently out and a count of how many are lent.",
  "noun": "book",
  "noun_plural": "books",
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "title",
      "label": "Title",
      "kind": "text",
      "required": true,
      "options": [],
      "integer": false,
      "unit": "",
      "in_form": true,
      "message": "Title is required"
    },
    {
      "name": "author",
      "label": "Author",
      "kind": "text",
      "required": true,
      "options": [],
      "integer": false,
      "unit": "",
      "in_form": true,
      "message": "Author is required"
    },
    {
      "name": "category",
      "label": "Category",
      "kind": "select",
      "required": true,
      "options": ["Novel", "Cookbook", "Reference"],
      "integer": false,
      "unit": "",
      "in_form": true,
      "message": "Category is required"
    },
    {
      "name": "borrower",
      "label": "Borrower",
      "kind": "text",
      "required": false,
      "options": [],
      "integer": false,
      "unit": "",
      "in_form": false,
      "message": ""
    }
  ],
  "title_field": "title",
  "subtitle_fields": ["author"],
  "meta_fields": ["category"],
  "constants": [],
  "filters": [
    {
      "kind": "state",
      "field": "borrower",
      "id": "lent-out",
      "label": "Lent out",
      "rule": "borrower is not empty"
    ,
    "empty_text": "No books are lent out."
    },
    {
      "kind": "field",
      "field": "category",
      "id": "by-category",
      "label": "By category",
      "rule": "category equals the selected option",
      "empty_text": "No books in this category."
    }
  ],
  "badges": [
    {
      "id": "lent-to",
      "rule": "borrower is not empty",
      "tone": "info",
      "text": "Lent to {borrower}"
    }
  ],
  "stats": [
    {
      "id": "lent-out-count",
      "label": "Lent out",
      "rule": "count of rows where borrower is not empty"
    ,
    "emphasis": true
    }
  ],
  "actions": [
    {
      "id": "lend",
      "label": "Lend",
      "available_rule": "borrower is empty",
      "effect": "set borrower to the input",
      "input_label": "Borrower name"
    ,
    "input_required": true
    ,
    "confirm_text": ""
    ,
    "toast": "Book lent"
    },
    {
      "id": "return",
      "label": "Return",
      "available_rule": "borrower is not empty",
      "effect": "set borrower to empty",
      "input_label": "",
      "input_required": false,
      "confirm_text": "",
      "toast": "Book returned"
    }
  ],
  "journeys": [
    {
      "title": "adds a book and shows it in the list",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Open the app; press Add; enter Title, Author, choose Category; save.",
      "expect": "The new book appears in the list with its Title, Author, and Category."
    },
    {
      "title": "rejects an empty required field",
      "kind": "implied",
      "steps": "Press Add; leave Title empty; save.",
      "expect": "The form shows 'Title is required' and does not save."
    },
    {
      "title": "edits an existing book",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Open a book; press Edit; change Title; save.",
      "expect": "The book's Title is updated in the list."
    },
    {
      "title": "deletes a book added by mistake",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Open a book; press Delete; confirm.",
      "expect": "The book is removed from the list."
    },
    {
      "title": "lends a book and shows the borrower",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Open a book; press Lend; enter a Borrower name; save.",
      "expect": "The book shows the badge 'Lent to {borrower}'."
    },
    {
      "title": "returns a book and clears the borrower",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Open a lent book; press Return.",
      "expect": "The 'Lent to {borrower}' badge disappears and the Borrower is empty."
    },
    {
      "title": "filters to books currently lent out",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Press the 'Lent out' filter.",
      "expect": "Only books with a Borrower are shown."
    },
    {
      "title": "filters books by category",
      "kind": "implied",
      "steps": "Press the 'By category' filter; choose 'Novel'.",
      "expect": "Only books whose Category is 'Novel' are shown."
    },
    {
      "title": "shows how many books are lent out",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Look at the 'Lent out' stat.",
      "expect": "It shows the count of rows where borrower is not empty."
    },
    {
      "title": "preserves data across a browser refresh",
      "kind": "implied",
      "steps": "Add or lend a book; refresh the browser.",
      "expect": "All books, borrowers, and the 'Lent out' count remain unchanged."
    }
  ],
  "omitted_patterns": [
    {
      "pattern": "multi-user or shared access",
      "reason": "The idea states it is just the user on their own computer."
    },
    {
      "pattern": "due dates or return deadlines",
      "reason": "The idea only mentions noting the borrower and clearing it on return."
    },
    {
      "pattern": "search by title or author",
      "reason": "The idea asks for a single list and a lent-out filter, not text search."
    }
  ]
  ,
  "assumptions": [
    "The category select is limited to Novel, Cookbook, and Reference as the examples given.",
    "The 'Lend' action prompts for a borrower name and stores it in the Borrower field.",
    "The 'Return' action clears the Borrower field."
  ]
}
